thesis: Patent licensor with about 1.1B USD cash and investments, 2.0B USD contracted revenue backlog, rising dividend and buybacks; closed 286.53 on 2026-11-05 after falling 14% from 2026-10-29 (334.27), around the Q3 report.
counterthesis: Revenue is lumpy and settlement driven: 9M 2026 smartphone revenue fell 34% and 203.6M of 9M revenue is catch-up. Three arbitrations carry 202.0M of non-cash contract assets built on management estimates (Samsung ICC award 1.05B is challenged). Q3 operating cash flow was 150.4M vs 395.9M a year earlier. Three licensees are 72% of receivables and contract assets. The 296.7M 2027 convertible matures 2027-06-01.
invalidation: An arbitration or court outcome (Samsung jurisdiction ruling, Lenovo 1H 2027) well below carried estimates, a lost or unrenewed major licence, or contract assets written down; OCF staying below net income for several quarters.
